reviews.text: Excellent service! I've taken my cat there several times for vaccinations, including microchipping, and all the doctors have always been very kind. They also helped me understand the requirements for traveling with my cat and everything else. 🩷
Excellent care from the doctors; all the staff are very good and know their stuff. They are very thorough with the tests, very good at guiding us and answering all our questions. ☺️

The vaccine they mention for cats that's first tested (SNAP) is the FIV/FeLV vaccine. They test for it because if the cat is positive and is vaccinated, it can worsen the cat's condition, but the vaccine protects against transmission from other cats. It's essential for cats that go outdoors because the disease is contagious.
The service at ACC is excellent. The doctors are kind, professional, and a great support, truly. Highly recommended.
The best stews in the universe.
We didn't like the service from the person at the counter, nor did they pay attention to what we were looking for.

I used to go there because, although they're not the best, basic services like vaccinations aren't expensive. But after this experience, I prefer to pay more but go to people who are responsible.
I took my cat to complete her vaccination record so I could get her spayed. The doctor who saw me said he couldn't give her the vaccine without a test. I agreed, seeing that it was "necessary." The test came back negative, but he still wanted to give her the vaccine. In his explanation before the tests, the doctor said they wouldn't give the vaccine without knowing if she was sick or not. Logically, if the test is negative, then they don't give it. Anyway, after subjecting the kitten, who was super nervous because she doesn't go outside, to the procedure (which I didn't witness because they wouldn't let me in), he asked me if the cat goes outside. I said no, and he replied, "Then she doesn't need it." Why didn't he ask me if the cat went outside before doing the procedure? It's only necessary if the cat goes outside. Just to make money. The cat didn't need to go through their "test," but apparently they needed the money anyway. Terrible, I never went back.
The service is the best; they give you advice and are very honest.

They treat pets incredibly well. I took my kitten there for urinary problems and because another vet had injured his paw, and they've taken excellent care of him. They're very understanding and keep in constant communication to follow up with your pets. They answer calls quickly and are always ready to help with anything you need.

They also helped me with a cat who recently gave birth. I called to ask if I should bring her in, and they were incredibly helpful despite the late hour. They even did an ultrasound to make sure everything was okay and gave us advice on how to keep my cat healthy.
Excellent service from all the staff, and they also had the microchip I was looking for
Excellent place to take your pets, high-quality, caring care, and they also sell food and accessories for our beloved companions. Dr. Cielo is highly recommended for exotic patients.

The blonde vet with glasses is very, very kind, and I trust her.

There have been others who look younger but don't inspire much confidence, because of the way they treat you and the things they explain, but if she's there, try to get her to see you personally.

Dr. Cielo is the best! Her care is so personalized, and you can tell she loves her job!
The hospital is clean and has everything you need.
Excellent pet care; if you have exotic pets, this is the place.
